title: capture-requests: answer its provider notices
prior_work: Answer this module's provider notices, judged affected by a read-only triage: ai-runs:96 (index.mjs:138 and :442 read ai_runs.principal_claude, which PR 96 renamed to principal_ai; store-assembly sweep.test fails CAPTURE_ATTRIBUTION_ONE_PRINCIPAL on it). For each, decide from your own requirements what this module must do, adapt or confirm, and add a test of your own for the change, failing with it reverted where code changes; where your requirements decide nothing, name the gap in not-verified. Edit no other module, and commit no generated file (rows.mjs, words-unreviewed.json, any dist; restore dist/*.bundle.json from HEAD if a build rewrites them). Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead.

status.reason: For BOB. Pushed 28bb94c6. Notice ai-runs:96 is answered. The bug: index.mjs:442 read runFor's principal_claude, which ai-runs R9/R28 renamed to principal_ai. So every run's request was written with an empty paying principal and refused CAPTURE_ATTRIBUTION_ONE_PRINCIPAL at the drain. It now reads principal_ai. index.mjs:138 was not a bug: it reads this module's own capture_requests.principal_claude column, which Terms and R8 still name. The fixture's hand-built run sight now answers principal_ai. New test notice-ai-runs-96.test.mjs opens a run with ai-runs' real code, passes its real runFor to the door, and checks that the row and attribution carry the run's principal_ai. It fails with the fix reverted. plane.test's airunopen now passes principalAi/principalAiRef. Suite: 126 pass, 7 fail. All 7 are plane.test's world(), failing at accountreferenceset (UNKNOWN_OP, retired by ai-accounts T53). They were red before this branch, and the cause is outside this module. Without an account, airunopen answers AI_NO_ACCOUNT. Through the door, aiownadd answers NOT_YOUR_ACCOUNT, because ai-accounts' arm (src/ai-accounts/index.mjs:90) builds the owner as member:${by}, and the door's by is already member:ruth. That is the scheduler job's blocker (1) too. ALSO FOR BOB: store-assembly's sweep.test still fails 2 tests, now because its own fixture inserts ai_runs.principal_claude (test/m/store-assembly/sweep.test.mjs:150), a column PR 96 renamed. That is store-assembly's to fix. GAP: this module's requirements (Terms, R8, R10, R48) still name the row column principal_claude and the attribution field principals.claude. ai-runs R9 removes 'claude' from its own words but decides nothing here, so they were kept. TO UNBLOCK: fix aiownadd's owner, and have store-assembly pass ai-accounts the catalogue if needed. This job then moves plane.test to aiownadd and runs job complete with --test notice:ai-runs:96=bio-plane/test/m/capture-requests/notice-ai-runs-96.test.mjs. Or rule plane.test's 7 an accepted red and restart for job complete now.
